title: Schedule of Early Termination Fees — Residential Natural Gas Supply
content:
Each Residential Natural Gas Supply plan names one method for its early termination fee: none, a flat fee, or a fee per remaining month of the term. Amounts are in US dollars.

## Fee method and amounts

| Plan | Method | Flat fee | Fee per remaining month | Ceiling before any state cap | Fee-free window before the contract end date (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable | none | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Capped Variable 12 | flat | 50.00 | 0.00 | 50.00 | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 | flat | 75.00 | 0.00 | 75.00 | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 | per remaining month | 0.00 | 5.00 | 100.00 | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36 | per remaining month | 0.00 | 5.00 | 150.00 | 45 |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 12 | flat | 75.00 | 0.00 | 75.00 | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24 | per remaining month | 0.00 | 5.00 | 100.00 | 30 |

The fee-free window is the number of calendar days immediately before the contract end date during which a cancellation carries no early termination fee.

## Waivers and state cap

| Plan | Waived on a utility move-out | Waived for a customer in a utility customer assistance program | No fee on an allowed mid-term move to a gas plan with an equal or longer term | Statutory state cap on residential fees |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable | Yes | Yes | Yes | IL: 50.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Capped Variable 12 | Yes | Yes | Yes | IL: 50.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 | Yes | Yes | Yes | IL: 50.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 | Yes | Yes | Yes | IL: 50.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36 | Yes | Yes | Yes | IL: 50.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 12 | Yes | Yes | Yes | IL: 50.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24 | Yes | Yes | Yes | IL: 50.00 |

The state cap is a per-state statutory ceiling on residential early termination fees. Illinois (IL) is the only state listed, at 50.00; a state absent from the list imposes no cap.

### Illustrations (hypothetical premises)

- A per-remaining-month plan with 9 remaining months: 5.00 multiplied by 9 is 45.00, below the 100.00 ceiling of Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24, so the ceiling does not bind.
- The same plan with 23 remaining months: 5.00 multiplied by 23 is 115.00, limited to the 100.00 ceiling; at an Illinois premise the 50.00 state cap then limits it to 50.00.
- Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 at a Pennsylvania premise: the flat 75.00 stands, since Pennsylvania carries no cap.
